confidence_notes: Holistic model estimates, not checked against live listings or booking pages. Restaurant and café anchors are moderately certain for a provincial French city. Hostel and hotel anchors are less certain because July coincides with the Festival d'Avignon, which can push accommodation well above normal. The FX observation came from search-result summaries that I could not open directly, so the 15 Oct 2026 RBA figure should be verified on the RBA page before use.
comparable_city_reasoning: Benchmarked to mid-sized Provençal tourist cities such as Aix-en-Provence and Arles, with prices set slightly below Paris. July accommodation is uplifted for festival demand. Conversion assumes roughly 1.16 USD per EUR.
